reason: I've had worsening neck pain after a rear-end car bump.
diagnosis: Whiplash-associated cervical strain after a low-speed rear-end collision, with delayed onset neck pain, stiffness, and paraspinal/trapezius tenderness but no neurologic deficits or midline spinal tenderness.
keyPoints: Mechanism of injury: rear-end impact, head/neck movement, seatbelt use, speed, airbags
Timing and progression of pain, immediate vs delayed onset
Neurologic red flags: numbness, tingling, weakness, dizziness, confusion, headache, vision changes
Midline cervical spine tenderness vs paraspinal/trapezius muscle tenderness
Range of motion limitation and pain with flexion/extension/rotation
Associated injuries/red flags: bruising, deformity, swelling, loss of consciousness, chest pain
Past neck injuries and relevant medical history/medications including anticoagulants
